language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially rests on the turquoise plate (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its gripper around the spoon and lifts it clear of the plate (frames 48–79, left_ego_image and wrist_image), then carries it to the open drawer (frames 90–124, image and wrist_image). The gripper opens and releases the spoon into the drawer (frames 125–130, wrist_image); the spoon remains visibly inside as the empty gripper withdraws (frames 131–137, wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is established.
